# 从水分子的位移箭头到特征标: # From water displacement arrows to characters
在“群论课堂 → 基础与表示 → 水分子、特征标与光谱演示”中，展开“水的特征标: In Symmetry classroom → Fundamentals and representations → Water, characters and spectroscopy, expand “How does water acquire a character of −1?”. Answer a prediction, then calculate manually. Opening the workshop, choosing an operation or choosing a matrix column does not start a calculation.
分子放在 xz 平面，二重轴沿 z。O 位于原点，H1 位于正 x 一侧，H2: The molecule lies in the xz plane, with its twofold axis along z. O is at the origin; H1 is on the positive-x side and H2 on the negative-x side. The drawing uses relative bond lengths and a 104.5° bond angle. These coordinates illustrate atom and arrow positions. Matrices and characters use exact integers.
九个基矢按 Ox、Oy、Oz、H1x、H1y、H1z、H2x、H2y、H2z 排: The nine basis vectors are ordered Ox, Oy, Oz, H1x, H1y, H1z, H2x, H2y, H2z. Each describes one Cartesian displacement of one atom, rather than one normal mode. Active operations act on column vectors; column j records the image of basis vector j.
1. 跟踪原子。选择 E、C₂(z)、σ(xz) 或 σ(yz)，比较原始位置和: 1. Track atoms. Choose E, C₂(z), σ(xz) or σ(yz), then compare initial and transformed positions. H1/H2 are tracking labels; the two hydrogen atoms have the same atomic type.
2. 跟踪方向。选择九个基矢之一，查看原子去向与位移方向的符号，再定位九维矩阵的: 2. Track directions. Choose one of nine basis vectors, inspect its destination atom and directional sign, then locate its column in the nine-dimensional matrix. One Python calculation returns all 36 columns of the four operations.
3. 只加对角元。C₂ 把 H1、H2 交换，相关矩阵元素落在非对角块。O 的位: 3. Add only diagonal entries. C₂ exchanges H1 and H2, placing their entries in off-diagonal blocks. O stays at its site, but Ox, Oy and Oz contribute −1, −1 and +1. The character is therefore −1. The number of fixed atoms alone is not the displacement character.
4. 扣除刚体运动，再约化。平移按极矢量 R 变换；无穷小转动按轴矢量 det(: 4. Remove rigid motions and reduce. Translations transform as polar vectors R; infinitesimal rotations transform as axial vectors det(R)R, whose mirror characters differ. Subtract both three-dimensional characters operation by operation, then use the complete four-operation character table to calculate irrep multiplicities.
5. 接回偏振。比较现有 z、x 红外和 xx、xz 拉曼通道。两份 A₁ 是两: 5. Return to polarization. Compare the existing z and x infrared channels and xx and xz Raman channels. Two A₁ copies are two vibrational degrees of freedom of the same one-dimensional symmetry type; that label does not require equal frequencies.
以原子为外层、方向为内层排序时，位移表示为 D(g)=P(g)⊗R(g)。P 将: With atoms as the outer index and Cartesian directions as the inner index, the displacement representation is D(g)=P(g)⊗R(g). P maps atom labels to destination sites, while R transforms displacement directions. Hence χ₃N(g)=Tr(P(g))Tr(R(g)). The operation order is always E, C₂(z), σ(xz), σ(yz).
该约定得到 χ₃N=(9,−1,3,1)、χT=(3,−1,1,1)、χR=(3: This convention gives χ₃N=(9,−1,3,1), χT=(3,−1,1,1) and χR=(3,−1,−1,−1). The vibrational character after subtraction is (3,1,3,1), reducing to 2A₁+B₁. Swapping the x/y convention exchanges B₁/B₂ labels; check the molecular plane and mirror-column order before comparing textbooks.
工坊解释有限群的位移表示与对称性许可，不求解力常数、正常模混合、真实峰位或强度。: The workshop explains a finite-group displacement representation and symmetry permission. It does not solve force constants, normal-mode mixing, measured peak positions or intensities. The original animation remains an explicitly schematic symmetry-adapted displacement. Character subtraction here applies to this nonlinear three-atom model, rather than replacing rigid-motion analysis for general linear molecules.
输入、结果、预测和笔记与原水分子动画、点群实验及课程自测分开保存。导出包含固定计: Inputs, results, predictions and notes are stored separately from the original water animation, point-group experiment and course quiz. Export includes the fixed calculation input and complete action ledger; predictions do not count toward course grades.
